    About this item

    • Dimensions: Top: Sleeve Length from Shoulder- 30 inches, Chest- 50 inches, Length- 30 inches. The Bottom or Pant Length is 40 inches. Ideal for shirt size XL.
    • Material: Made from High Quality Polyester fabric
    • Construction: This Reversible Use Rainwear is made from double layered polyester fabric. Every joint is seam sealed with additional leak proof stitching making it completely waterproof. Overlaying flap with snap buttons over zippers prevents water seepage. It also comes with high collars, adjustable hood and side pockets with flaps for added protection. Small inner pocket to protect mobile or any other expensive items.Good quality elastics in trousers makes it super comfortable to wear.
    • Safety: Front and back reflective stripes assure safety while traveling in low lighting. Our lightweight, breathable and quick drying raingear are perfect for Bikers, Office Goers, Hiking, Camping, Cycling, Construction Workers, Farmers, etc.
    • Easy Storage: Available with zipper bag for easy storage. Can comfortably carry in your backpack or your bike storage compartment for handy use

    ABOUT THE BRAND

    The Clownfish is an enhanced brand that endorses premium quality designed bags that are known for endurance, durability, and elegance. We have an exclusive top-rated collection of bags that complement every mood of our customers, ranging from briefcases, messenger bags, backpacks, duffels, and many more.

    The Clownfish understands the needs of the modern consumer and on that basis, it designs its product which is adherent to style, color, mood as well as quality. Presently, The Clownfish has 500 plus products in its house which are designed efficiently from leather, leatherette, polyester, canvas, nylon, etc. Thus offering a wide number of choices to the customers. We at The Clownfish prioritize our customers and deliver the best service we can and ensure maximum satisfaction.

    Customers say

    Customers find the raincoat to be of good quality and value for money. The water resistance receives mixed feedback - while some praise the waterproofing, others report water getting inside. Customers disagree on the fit, with some finding it perfect while others say it's too tight for 38-inch hips. The material quality and size also receive mixed reviews, with some appreciating the double-layered construction while others find it poor, and some finding the size perfect while others say it's too small. The durability is concerning, with reports of tearing after days of use, and customers note the lack of a storage pouch.

      I recently purchased this raincoat, and I must say, it has exceeded my expectations in every way! The coat is made of a high-quality, waterproof material that keeps me completely dry even in the heaviest of downpours. The breathable fabric ensures that I stay comfortable and dry from the inside out.

      The design is sleek and stylish, with a fitted silhouette that looks great on both men and women. The adjustable cuffs and hem provide a secure fit, preventing rain from seeping in. The hood is spacious and adjustable, allowing me to easily wear a helmet over it

      I've worn this raincoat in some pretty intense rainstorms, and it has performed flawlessly. The water simply beads up and rolls off, leaving me looking and feeling great. The coat is also lightweight and packable, making it easy to carry around in my backpack.
